name: Tidio
description: Tidio is a customer service platform combining live chat, a help desk, and the Lyro AI agent, which can independently handle a large share of repetitive support conversations.
best_for: Around 300,000 businesses wanting AI-assisted customer service without replacing their human support team, particularly ecommerce sites on Shopify and WordPress.
features: Lyro AI agent for automated conversation handling
Live chat widget for real-time website engagement
Flows automation for lead capture and sales
Integrations with Shopify, WordPress, HubSpot, and Zapier
Native desktop and mobile apps across Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 50 billable conversations/month, 50 one-time Lyro AI conversations, 100 Flows visitors/month.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Starting price, scales with usage. 250+ billable conversations/month, 50+ Lyro AI conversations/month. Marked "Popular".

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Starting price + monthly usage charges on top. Custom conversation limits, dedicated success manager, requires contacting sales for exact pricing.

cons: Above the Free plan, pricing scales with conversation volume rather than being a flat per-tier price -- Growth and Plus are both "starting at" prices that increase with usage.
The Free plan's Lyro AI allotment (50 conversations) is one-time, not monthly -- ongoing AI automation requires a paid tier.

alternatives.name: Intercom
alternatives.description: A customer messaging platform combining live chat, help desk, and AI-powered support agents.
alternatives.best_for: SaaS companies wanting conversational, in-app customer engagement.

alternatives.name: Crisp
alternatives.description: An all-in-one support platform combining live chat, AI agents, and a shared inbox.
alternatives.best_for: Startups to enterprises wanting a lightweight, chat-first support tool.

alternatives.name: LiveAgent
alternatives.description: An all-in-one help desk merging email, chat, phone, and social into one dashboard.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses handling multiple channels wanting fast live chat.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: Zendesk is an AI-first customer service platform combining self-learning AI agents with unified ticketing and omnichannel workflow tools, serving both customer service and internal employee service use cases.
alternatives.best_for: Positioned for customer service teams, employee/IT/HR service departments, and contact centers spanning startups to large enterprises across industries like retail, financial services, healthcare, and government.
strengths: AI agents that autonomously resolve tickets end-to-end
Unified omnichannel inbox (email, chat, phone, social, messaging)

alternatives.name: Gorgias
alternatives.description: Gorgias is a conversational AI platform built for ecommerce businesses, combining a helpdesk and AI agent to handle customer conversations across channels while aiming to drive revenue.
alternatives.best_for: Positioned specifically for ecommerce brands and Shopify merchants — the site states Gorgias "powers customer conversations for 40% of Shopify brands," spanning clothing, beauty, subscriptions, health & wellness, and food & beverage.
strengths: AI support agent resolving inquiries instantly (site claims 60%)
AI shopping assistant for product recommendations/upselling
Native Shopify integration with live order/customer data

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: Help Scout is a customer service platform that centralizes email and other communication channels into a shared inbox, with AI-assisted drafting and a chatbot, to help teams deliver personalized support.
alternatives.best_for: Positioned for teams of any size (12,000+ companies) across SaaS, ecommerce, education, healthcare, financial services, insurance, manufacturing, and professional services.
strengths: Unified shared inbox aggregating email, social, Shopify, and other channels
AI drafting/editing and automated thread recaps/translation
Beacon AI chatbot (resolves ~73% of interactions per site claim)
